more_info.overview: Mineral oil is a liquid mixture of petroleum hydrocarbons, distinct from semi-solid petrolatum and solid petroleum wax. FDA specifies white mineral oil for limited food-processing uses, with purity requirements for the commercial material. Its applications include release, lubrication, dust control and protective coating in specified processes. The permitted purpose and amount depend on the food or operation. A food-use specification for refined oil cannot be applied to an unrefined petroleum product.
